:::{#sol-matrix-from-rows-practice}

Stacking the three [row](#def-matrix-row)s from top to bottom gives

$$
\ba
\matr{M}
&= \begin{bmatrix} \matr{M}_{1,:} \\ \matr{M}_{2,:} \\ \matr{M}_{3,:} \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(@thm-matrix-column-of-rows)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 4 \end{bmatrix},
&& \text{(substitute the rows)}
\ea
$$

so the second [column of $\matr{M}$](#def-matrix-column) lists the second entry of each [row](#def-matrix-row):

$$
\matr{M}_{:,2} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ -1 \\ 4 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
